references.text: Jacob blesses Judah and mentions that he ties his donkey to the vine, a parallel to the riders on white donkeys as symbols of wealth and peace.
Balaam rides on his donkey, illustrating the use of donkeys as riding animals for important figures in ancient Israel.
The sons of Jair rode on thirty young donkeys, indicating status and wealth, similar to those who ride on white donkeys in Deborah's song.
Abdon's sons and grandsons rode on seventy young donkeys, a parallel to the status of those who ride on donkeys.
Ziba meets David with a pair of donkeys, showing the donkey's role as a means of transport for royalty and leaders.
The prophecy about the king coming riding on a donkey, humble and gentle, links donkey riding to messianic expectation.
Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey, fulfilling Zechariah 9:9 and connected to images of peaceful leaders riding on donkeys.
